questions.prompt: Which treaty formally created the European Union in 1993?
questions.fact: It also laid out the path to a single currency, which arrived as notes and coins nine years later.

questions.prompt: Which scientist proposed that species change through natural selection alongside a theory of inheritance he did not have?
questions.fact: Mendel's work on inheritance was published in his lifetime and he appears never to have read it.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a term called the sin bin?
questions.fact: Football trialled it in lower leagues, and its wider adoption has been debated for years.

questions.prompt: Which sitcom features a character called Del Boy?
questions.fact: One episode drew over twenty-four million UK viewers, a record for a sitcom that still stands.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Bay of Fundy?
questions.fact: It has the highest tidal range on Earth, with water rising more than sixteen metres twice a day.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Sydney Carton's resemblance to another man?
options: The Man in the Iron Mask
